abstract.p: The narratives of the ongoing Nakba are of significant importance for both the Palestinian people and the global community. The creation of language resources is crucial to automating the processing of written content related to this historical event. This paper introduces an annotated Named Entity Recognition (NER) dataset derived from a collection of 182 news articles about the Nakba and its witnesses. Given their prominence as a primary source of information on the Nakba in Turkish, news articles were selected as the primary data source. An initial analysis on the constructed dataset is also presented.
